plan.purpose: isolate the two first-round changes; no production source changes

diagnostic.scope: Separate forwarding interposers count actual native server syscalls over setup, warmup, timed work and shutdown. Absent from all 32 formal timing executables. Diagnostic timing is not used as performance evidence. Counts normalize kevent calls by successful server send calls, not by timed responses; positive short sends were not separately counted.

limits: Single local closed-loop driver and server share one process; CPU includes both.
Only health_c64 was rerun. Eight forward/reverse groups are exploratory; all modified variants have mixed paired signs.
No thread CPU, context-switch, CPU frequency, power-mode or host-contention profile was captured. A run-variation cause cannot be attributed to one scheduler/host mechanism.
No production source, benchmark driver or configuration was changed in this investigation.
Diagnostic counters include warmup and teardown and their overhead makes diagnostic throughput unsuitable for performance comparison.
disposable_output_cleanup: All task-owned source/build copies and instrumented executables deleted after retaining this evidence.
